say:3:1760007001:0.text: I knew Agumon could do it! That was a spectacular battle!
say:3:1760007001:0.source_cn: 不愧是我看好的新生代，为我们献上了一场精彩绝伦的战斗！

say:4:1760007002:0.text: Now, let's hear a few words from our victors—
say:4:1760007002:0.source_cn: 那么，有请我们的胜者发言——

say:5:1760007003:0.text: Yay, I won! Please grant my wish!
say:5:1760007003:0.source_cn: 我赢了，现在实现我之前许下的愿望吧！

say:6:1760007004:0.text: Haha, I like how straightforward you are!
say:6:1760007004:0.source_cn: 哈哈，这位小勇士的性格还真是直接呢！

say:8:1760007005:0.text: You need help looking for a friend, don't you? I always keep my word!
say:8:1760007005:0.source_cn: 你想找人对吧？放心吧，我曼卡拉说到做到！

say:9:1760007006:0.text: I've found just the right person for you! Satrana can help through her divination!
say:9:1760007006:0.source_cn: 看，我已经帮你找到能实现愿望的人选啦！她就是——占卜师...

say:14:1760007007:0.text: Hi, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Feels like ages since we last met!
say:14:1760007007:0.male: Hi, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Feels like ages since we last met!
say:14:1760007007:0.female: Hi, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Feels like ages since we last met!

say:15:1760007008:0.text: Now, describe your friend's appearance and unique traits to me. My Crystal Ignis will give you guidance!
say:15:1760007008:0.source_cn: 请向我描述一下那个人的长相和特征，炎晶之眼会为你们提供指引！

narration:16:1760007009:0.text: Yamato gives Satrana a detailed description of Gabumon...
narration:16:1760007009:0.source_cn: 大和详细谨慎、事无巨细地向萨忒娜描述了加布兽……

say:17:1760007010:1.text: He sounds absolutely adorable. Alright, I'll take it from here!
say:17:1760007010:1.source_cn: 听上去是很可爱的小家伙呢。好，交给我吧！

say:18:1760007011:1.text: In the stream of time, we divine, past the worldly veil we shine...
say:18:1760007011:1.source_cn: 上溯时光之流，超脱世俗的迷障……追寻迷途者的踪迹……

say:19:1760007012:1.text: Ah, I see something... Books floating above a lake... Overflowing magic... A sinister graveyard... Students holding books in a classroom...
say:19:1760007012:1.source_cn: 啊！我看到了……漂浮的群书，广袤的湖泊，丰盈的魔力气息...

say:20:1760007013:1.text: That's all. Does any of it ring a bell?
say:20:1760007013:1.source_cn: 我能看到的只有这些了。怎么样，有头绪了吗？

choice_prompt:21:1760007013.text: That's all. Does any of it ring a bell?
choice_prompt:21:1760007013.source_cn: 我能看到的只有这些了。怎么样，有头绪了吗？

say:24:1760007015:0.text: A school? Must be safe, then!
say:24:1760007015:0.source_cn: 太好了，听起来是个很安全的地方！

say:25:1760007016:1.text: Safe? After everything you went through at the Serene Lyceum, you're not so sure about that.
say:25:1760007016:1.source_cn: 安全？联想到之前在莱希拉姆的经历，你对此表示怀疑。
say:25:1760007016:1.male: Safe? After everything you went through at the Serene Lyceum, you're not so sure about that.
say:25:1760007016:1.female: Safe? After everything you went through at the Serene Lyceum, you're not so sure about that.

say:26:1760007017:1.text: After resting for the night, you set out for the Serene Lyceum the next day...
say:26:1760007017:1.source_cn: 为确保万无一失，你们决定休整一夜后，就即刻出发前往莱希...
say:26:1760007017:1.male: After resting for the night, you set out for the Serene Lyceum the next day...
say:26:1760007017:1.female: After resting for the night, you set out for the Serene Lyceum the next day...

choice:23:1:2.text: I once studied and worked there.
choice:23:1:2.male: I once studied and worked there.
choice:23:1:2.female: I once studied and worked there.
